title: Ask toward an open problem: The mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-PHYS-HTSC: What pairs the electrons in the copper-oxide superconductors, and what sets their transition temperature? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-PHYS-HTSC saying how its answer would bear on the problem.

problem_source.title: From quantum matter to high-temperature superconductivity in copper oxides
